items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: That was the Sonny South band.

ctx.x: Uh, it's hard to tell who I played with. Yeah. I wouldn't play with that, just to remember. But one of the bands I got in after that was one of the bands that always feel that the best band I ever played with. That was the Sonny South band.
